items.question:
A financial reporting analyst at a bank produces monthly regulatory capital reports using Claude. He currently exports a 30-tab spreadsheet from the core banking system each month and uploads it to a Claude session. His bank's IT team can configure a connector to the reporting database. He is evaluating whether to invest in the connector.

What factor MOST justifies the connector investment for this recurring workflow?

options.A: The connector will give Claude access to a more capable model, improving the quality of the regulatory analysis.
options.B: The connector eliminates the monthly export step, ensures Claude sees current data rather than a month-end snapshot, and removes the risk of upload failures on large files.
options.C: The connector enables Research mode to automatically cross-reference the banking data against public regulatory benchmarks.
options.D: The connector will automatically store the monthly reports in Project knowledge for audit access.
